senses.gloss: सम—धर्म mf(आ)n. (ifc.) of equal nature or character, resembling, BhP.
सम—धा ind. equally with (instr.), Gaut.
सम्-आधा m. (only L.) putting together, adjusting, settling, reconciling, clearing up difficulties &c.
completion, accomplishment.
सम—धुर mfn. (for स-मध्˚ See p. 1154) bearing an equal burden with (gen.), Ragh.
स-मधुर mfn. (for सम-ध्˚ See p. 1152, col. 3) sweet, L.
स-मधुरा f. a grape, L.
सम—धृत mfn. made eq˚ in weight, Mn.; Viṣṇ.
equal or equivalent to, W.
सम्-अधिक mf(आ)n. superabundant, superfluous, excessive, exceeding (with मास m. ‘more than a month, a month and more’), R.; VarBṛS.; Hit.
exceeding what is usual, extraordinary, intense, plentiful (अम् ind.), Kāv.; Sāh.
सम्-अधिकम् (अम्), ind.
सम्-अधिक—तर mfn. more abundant, exceeding, excessive
सम्-अधिक—तर—रूप mfn. more beautiful than (abl.), Ragh.
सम्-अधिक—त˚रोच्छ्वासिन् mfn. breathing or sighing more heavily, Megh.
सम्-अधिक—लज्जा-वती f. excessively ashamed or bashful, Sāh.
सम्-अधिक—लावण्य n. excessive loveliness or charm, ib.
समधिकारम्भ m. an extraordinary enterprise, Uttarar.
सम्-अधि-√ कृत् (only ind.p. -कृत्य), to cut up in addition or completely, MBh.
सम्-अधिगत mfn. gone quite near to, approached, BhP.
सम्-˚अधिगम m. thoroughly understanding, perceiving, ib.
सम्-˚अधिगमन n. going beyond or above, surpassing, overcoming, W.
सम्-˚अधिगम्य mfn. to be understood or perceived, Śaṃk.

सम्-अधि-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to rise up, mount, ascend, AitBr.; Hariv.;
to rise up to (the knowledge of), be convinced of MBh.
सम्-अधिरूढ mfn. one who has risen up or mounted (with तुलाम्, ‘brought into a critical condition’), Bālar.
convinced or (acc.), MBh.
सम्-˚अधिरोहण n. mounting up, ascending, Car.
सम्-अधि-√ शी Caus. -शाययति, to lay or put anything in the place of any other thing, Nid.

सम्-अधि-√ श्रि P. Ā. -श्रयति, ˚ते, to proceed or advance towards, approach, attack, MW.;
to put in or on the fire, MBh.
सम्-अधिष्ठान n. abiding, residing, KāśīKh.
सम्-अधिष्ठित mfn. standing upon (acc.), MBh.
standing above or at the highest place, Pañcar.
filling, penetrating (acc.), Car.
ridden or guided by (instr.), MBh.
सम्-अधि-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to glide or slide along, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सम्-अधी (-अधि-√ इ) Ā. -अधीते, to go over, repeat or read through or study thoroughly, Mn. vi, 93.
सम्-आधि m. putting together, joining or combining with (instr.), Lāṭy.
a joint or a partic. position of the neck, Kir.
union, a whole, aggregate, set, R.; Hariv.; Ragh.
completion, accomplishment, conclusion, Kum.
setting to rights, adjustment, settlement, MBh.
justification of a statement, proof, Sarvad.
bringing into harmony, agreement, assent, W.; RPrāt.
intense application or fixing the mind on, intentness, attention (˚धिं-√ कृ, ‘to attend’), MBh.; R. &c.

concentration of the thoughts, profound or abstract meditation, intense contemplation of any particular object (so as to identify the contemplator with the object meditated upon; this is the eighth and last stage of Yoga [IW. 93]; with Buddhists Samādhi is the fourth and last stage of Dhyāna or intense abstract meditation [MWB. 209]; in the Kāraṇḍa-vyūha several S˚ are enumerated), Up.; Buddh.; MBh. &c.
intense absorption or a kind of trance, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a sanctuary or tomb of a saint, W.; RTL. 261
(in rhet.) N. of various figures of speech (defined as आरोहावरोहक्रम, अर्थ-दृष्टि, अन्य-धर्माणाम् अन्यत्राधिरोहण &c.), Kāvyād.; Vām.; Kpr. &c.
N. of the 17th Kalpa (q.v.), of the 17th Arhat of the future Utsarpiṇī, L.

of a Vaiśya, Cat. (accord. to L. also ‘silence; a religious vow of intense devotion or self-imposed abstraction; support, upholding; continuance; perseverance in difficulties; attempting impossibilities; collecting or laying up grain in times of dearth’)
सम्-अधीत mfn. gone over, read through, studied, MBh.
सम्-˚आधित mfn. propitiated, reconciled, Kathās.
सम्-अध्ययन n. going over or studying together, (or) that which is gone over or repeated together, Āpast.
स-मध्यम mfn. moderate, Kull. on Mn. vii, 155.

सम्-अध्य्-√ आस् Ā. -आस्ते, to sit upon together, inhabit, occupy, R.; Ragh. :
Desid. -आसिसिषते, to wish to occupy, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-अध्यासित mfn. sat upon or occupied together (as a seat), Ragh.
सम्-अध्व mfn. being on the same road, travelling in company, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-˚आधातव्य mfn. to be put in order or set right, Hit.
सम्-आधान n. putting together, laying, adding (esp. fuel to fire), Gobh.
composing, adjusting, settling, and
reconciliation, MBh.
intentness, attention (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to attend’), eagerness, Śaṃk.; Pañcar.
fixing the mind in abstract contemplation (as on the true nature of spirit), religious meditation, profound absorption or contemplation, MBh.; Kāv.; Vedāntas.
justification of a statement, proof (cf. -रूपक), Sarvad.
(in logic) replying to the Pūrva-pakṣa, MW.
(in dram.) fixing the germ or leading incident (which gives rise to the whole plot, e.g. Śak. i, 27)
सम्-आधान—मात्र n. mere contemplation or meditation, MW.
सम्-आधान—रूपक n. a kind of metaphor (used for the justification of a bold assertion), Kāvyād.
सम्-˚आधानीय mfn. to be put together or joined, Uṇ. ii, 109, Sch.
सम्-˚आधायक mfn. composing, reconciling, Ṣaḍguruś.
सम्-आधि—गर्भ m. N. of a Bodhisattva, Buddh.
सम्-आधि—त्व n. the state of profound meditation or devotion, Sarvad.
सम्-आधि—निष्ठ mfn. devoted to m˚, Pañcat.
सम्-आधि—परिहाणि f. diminution of m˚, Dharmas. 59
सम्-आधि—प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
सम्-आधि—बल n. the force of m˚, Dharmas. 75
सम्-आधि—भङ्ग m. the disturbing or interruption of m˚, Pañcat.
सम्-आधि—भृत् mfn. absorbed in m˚, Śiś.
सम्-आधि—भेद m. (= -भङ्ग), Kum.
सम्-आधि—भेदिन् mfn. one who interrupts m˚, Ragh.
सम्-आधि—मत् mfn. absorbed in m˚, Kum.
attentive, R.
making a promise or assent or permission, W.
सम्-आधि—मतिका f. N. of a woman, Mālav. (v.l. for समाहितिका in B.)
सम्-आधि—योग m. employment of meditation, the efficacy of contemplation, MW.
सम्-आधि—योग-र्द्धि-तपो-विद्या-विरक्ति-मत् mfn. possessing or accompanied with m˚ and self-abstraction and supernatural power and mortification and knowledge and indifference, BhP.
सम्-आधि—राज m. N. of wk.
सम्-आधि—विग्रह m. embodiment of m˚
सम्-आधि—विधि m. N. of wk.
सम्-आधि—समानता f. N. of a Samādhi, Buddh.
सम्-आधि—स्थ mfn. absorbed in m˚, Pañcat.
सम्-आधि—स्थल n. N. of a place in Brahmā's world, Kathās.
सम्-˚आधित्सा f. (fr. Desid.) desire of settling or adjusting, KātyŚr., Sch.
सम्-˚आधित्सु mfn. (fr. id.) wishing to set right or prove, Nyāyas., Sch.
सम्-˚आधिन् mfn. absorbed in contemplation, W.
सम्-आधेय mfn. to be put in order or set right, R.
to be directed or informed or instructed, ib.
to be granted or admitted, Kull.; Siddh.
सम्-आ-√ धाव् P. Ā. -धावति, ˚ते, to run together towards, rush towards, run near to, MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-आ-धूत mfn. (√ धू) driven away, dispersed, scattered, R.
सम्-आ-√ ध्मा P. -धमति (only pf. -दध्मुः), to cause (musical instruments) to sound forth together, blow (a horn &c.), Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-आध्मात mfn. made to sound forth together, blown into, MBh.; Hariv.
swelled up, puffed up, swollen, inflated, Suśr.
सम्-आ-√ ध्यै P. -ध्यायति, to meditate deeply upon, reflect upon, be lost in thought, Hariv.; R.
साम—धर्मार्थ-नीतिमत् mfn. friendly and just and useful and wise (as speech), R.
साम—ध्वनि m. the sound of the chanting of the S˚, Mn. iv, 123 (see under -वेद, col. 2)
